limitations: Business web interface through the shared Web Host (contribution/gui.json); the other household members act only through events.
One household and one account per App instance.
No prices, stores, products, carts or orders; the shopping list is a record and is sent nowhere.
Nutrition values are illustrative and the suitability check is not medical, allergy or dietary advice.
No messaging in either direction; notifications stay in the App's own log.
